subject: elephant
pitch: A gentle African elephant calf. Wrinkly slate-grey skin with a dusty, reddish tint from rolling in the dirt, huge fan-shaped ears with a pink flush on the inside, a curious trunk curling forward, stubby baby tusks, long lashes over kind brown eyes, a little tufted tail and round, padded feet with pale toenails.
reasoning:
I'm working out which SDK functions are available without full documentation, trying to stick to the plausible API shapes I've seen like joints, chains, sweeps, and parts, since I'm not certain of the exact option signatures.

Still defining joints and geometry helpers...

Working out ear geometry...

Now mapping out the trunk curve as a series of joint positions curling down then forward from the face, tapering radius from 0.13 to 0.05 toward the tip.

I'm adding tusks as small forward-pointing cones near the mouth, and positioning eye spheres by computing where they sit on the head ellipsoid's surface.

Now I'm detailing the eyes with brown color and tiny white highlights, plus thin lash rods radiating outward, segmented tail with a tuft, pale toenail boxes on each foot, and darker horizontal wrinkle rings on the legs. I'm setting up a quaternion helper to orient cylindrical segments along arbitrary directions, and choosing a palette of dusty skin tones, darker shading, lighter belly, and pink accents.

Still working out leg and foot placement...
